tasks.zh: 未启用配置时使用原完整回复流程。
tasks.en: Without configuration, use the existing whole-reply flow.

tasks.zh: 显式启用后，一次只显示一条未确认分句，确认后追加下一句。
tasks.en: With opt-in streaming, reveal at most one unconfirmed segment, then append the next after confirmation.

tasks.zh: 切到后台标签页时不得产生新显示确认；返回后从快照继续。
tasks.en: A hidden tab must not send new display receipts; resume from a snapshot on return.

tasks.zh: 进入历史时保持草稿、停止新分句确认；返回后继续原气泡。
tasks.en: History preserves the draft and pauses new display receipts; returning continues the same bubble.

tasks.zh: 切换会话后，旧轮询和旧显示回执不得改变新会话。
tasks.en: Old polls and receipts cannot alter the new session after switching.

tasks.zh: 已显示前缀保留并标未完成，未显示缓冲尾部不出现。
tasks.en: Keep the displayed prefix with an incomplete label; never reveal an unshown buffered tail after failure.

tasks.zh: 模拟最后显示确认响应丢失，重试不追加重复文字或重复最终提交。
tasks.en: Drop a final display receipt response; retry without duplicate text or duplicate final application.

tasks.zh: 最终状态只升级原气泡；不自动播放全文，完整后可主动朗读。
tasks.en: Final upgrades the existing bubble; no automatic full-text speech, with manual read available once complete.

tasks.zh: 上翻阅读时新分句不拉到底部；主动查看最新后恢复跟随。
tasks.en: New segments do not force the viewport down while reading earlier text; explicitly jump to latest to resume following.

tasks.zh: 窄屏下中英混合文本、未完成标签及输入草稿均可阅读。
tasks.en: Mixed Chinese/English text, the incomplete label and the draft remain readable on a narrow screen.

tasks.zh: 聊天面板在整页视口外时不确认新分句；滚回面板可见后恢复。
tasks.en: Do not acknowledge a new segment while the conversation panel is outside the page viewport; resume when it is visible again.

tasks.zh: 保持跟随底部，多段同一气泡增高时先跟随滚动再确认；主动上翻后停止确认，查看最新后恢复。
tasks.en: While following the bottom, growing segments in the same bubble align before confirmation; explicitly scrolling up pauses receipts, and returning to latest resumes them.
